question: The Ministry of Environment and Forest launched Vahini Scheme in ______ with the basic objective of encouraging people's participation in environmental protection.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mon Jun 01 1992 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Ministry of Environment and Forest launched the Vahini Scheme on **1st June 1992**.
 
• The primary objective of the Vahini Scheme is to encourage **people's participation in environmental protection**.
 
• The initiative emphasizes **community involvement** to foster a sense of responsibility towards the environment among the citizens.
